prompt:
Image 1 is a finished game sprite sheet of a leader whose drawing is right: keep exactly its camera (high above and in front, looking down at about 40 degrees), the direction every figure faces, every figure's pose, size and position in its cell, the 4 by 4 grid and the flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) background.
Image 2 is this leader's own approved painted portrait. Every figure of Image 1 must become the priest of the portrait, seen full length from above.

Repaint every figure of Image 1 as the priest of Image 2, the same in every cell. Keep each figure's pose, the position of its arms, legs and weapon, and its outline as close as the new kit allows. They have these marks, and each one must be clearly visible at full size: (1) the wreath of willow catkins on the head; (2) the long grey hair in a single braid over the shoulder; (3) the old thoughtful beardless face; (4) the robe the colour of lichen to the ground, its hood down on the shoulders; (5) the clasp carved as a feather; (6) the tall staff of pale birch bound with strips of bark. They carry no shield. Paint the marks in the portrait's hand: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible directional brushwork, a muted earthy palette; nothing glows. Keep the daylight of Image 1 (a high sun from the upper left, a cool fill on the lower right); do not copy the portrait's candlelight, its dark background or its framing. They wear a Grove Priest's kit instead of the hooded druid's kit of Image 1: no hood over the head (the head is bare under their wreath, and any hood lies down on the shoulders), their own robe to the ground and clasp as the portrait shows them, and the staff named in the marks above, held where Image 1 holds its staff.

Facing, again: every figure in every one of the cells faces the same way, toward us and to the lower left, including the figure that is hit and the falling one; the fleeing figures alone turn away.

Background: one flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) colour fills the whole image with no gradient, texture, floor or shadow; no magenta, pink or purple anywhere on the figures. Never: text, labels, grid lines, borders, a floor, cast shadows, blood, extra people, cropped or overlapping figures.
